reviewItem.question: For "The following embedded cache metrics are removed", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether dashboards, alerts or recording rules reference querier_cache_added_total, querier_cache_gets_total or querier_cache_misses_total

proposed.statement: The embedded cache metrics querier_cache_added_total, querier_cache_gets_total and querier_cache_misses_total are removed in favour of loki_cache_fetched_keys, loki_cache_hits and loki_cache_request_duration_seconds.
